native_result.query: What proportion of studies in Experimental Economics were conducted in a lab setting?
native_result.HypoA: In Experimental Economics, all studies (both original and replication) were conducted in a lab setting (100%), while in Psychology, a small proportion of replication studies were also conducted online (8.8%)
native_result.HypoB: All studies in the Experimental Economics replication project were conducted in a physical lab setting: 18 of 18 unique original studies (100%) have online.o = 0, and the same holds for their replications (18/18 with online.r = 0); no original-replication pair mixes modalities.
native_result.WorkflowB: Loaded the meta-regression study dataset (927x57) with pandas; verified the 'ee' project has exactly 18 rows and 18 unique ids (one row per study, no multi-lab duplication; lab_id and aggregated are fully NA for ee); asserted drop==False and zero missingness in online.o/online.r/subjects.o/subjects.r/us_lab.o within ee; computed the primary proportion of lab-conducted original studies as count(online.o==0)/18 = 18/18 = 100%; secondary checks: replications online.r==0 in 18/18, cross-tab online.o x online.r showing all 18 pairs in cell (0,0), subjects.o distribution (students 17, community 1, none 'online'), us_lab.o as context only (11 US labs, 7 non-US), and explicit handling of ee.4 (subjects='community', online.o=0 -> counted as lab). Supporting per-study table exported to ee_lab_proportion_table.csv.
